scope: Corollary 5.6 (Uniform affine transforms on a zero interval) of the manuscript “Essential Singularity of the Correlation Length in the Planar XY Model” (preprints/Essential-Singularity-of-the-Correlation-Length-in-the-Planar-XY-Model-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 216 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5630748347a3657a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 41. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose I = [u, v] ⊂ (0, ∞) consists of continuity points of A and A = 0 on I. Fix a compact set K ⊂ R2 and λ ∈ R. For a free square of side m write Xm,p = (h, ABm (p · x/m)). Then sup m∈N: δk logL m∈I p∈K Efree Bm,bk eλXm,p − 1 −→ 0. (5.32) The assertion is unchanged by translating the squares or multiplying their sides by factors in a fixed compact subset of (0, ∞), provided their resulting logarithmic scales stay in a fixed zero-profile neighborhood of I.
